scientific_limitations: Only the fixed Jordan partition (m,1), with m at least 2, and a finite base field.
The classification of admissible Jordan types and maximal nilpotency bounds is already in the literature.
Historical equivalence of the explicit elementwise finite-field fibers remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Joint rank–nilpotency-index fibers in an almost-regular Jordan centralizer
